vacancy_details.details: The official notification announces vacancies for the DEO (Data Entry Operator) post under a temporary contractual basis at the National AYUSH Mission, Thrissur District.

salary_details.details: The notification does not mention any additional allowances or benefits.

selection_process: The selection process involves an interview. If more than 20 candidates are shortlisted
a written test and interview will be conducted on the basis of eligibility.
how_to_apply: Download the official notification and application form from the official resources.
Fill up all relevant fields of the application form carefully.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates proving age, educational qualifications, and residential address along with the application.
Enclose self-attested copies of certificates with originals where required for verification during submission.
Put the application in a sealed envelope.
Super scribe the cover of the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DEO (Data Entry Operator)".

Submit the sealed envelope directly or through post to The District Programme Manager, DPMSU, National AYUSH Mission, Rama Varma District Ayurveda Hospital Campus, Palace Road, Patturaikkal, Thrissur on or before 12-10-2026 by 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications must reach the District Programme Manager on or before 12-10-2026 by 5:00 PM. Applications received after 5:00 PM on 17/10/2026 will be summarily rejected (as per rejection rules). Applications submitted through E-mail will not be accepted. Applications in any format other than the format given along with the notification will be rejected. Applications without self-attested copies of certificates will be summarily rejected. Candidates must maintain a personal active E-mail ID and Mobile Number until the recruitment process concludes. Furnishing false, tampered, or fabricated information will lead to rejection of the application at any stage. If a candidate possesses equivalent qualification, the equivalency certificate must be produced along with the application.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment by National AYUSH Mission Thrissur?
faq.answer: National AYUSH Mission Thrissur has invited applications for the post of DEO (Data Entry Operator) on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the DEO post?
faq.answer: The exact vacancy count is not specified in the notification, but positions are open at the office of the District Programme Manager, Thrissur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 12-10-2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the DEO post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a degree along with a Government recognized Diploma in Computer Application (DCA) or Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Application (PGDCA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NAM Thrissur DEO recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is below 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their filled applications in a sealed envelope either directly or through post to the District Programme Manager's office before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection is based on an interview. If more than 20 candidates apply, a written test and interview will be conducted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for the DEO position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of 14,175/-.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled for 14/10/2026 at 10:30 AM at the National AYUSH Mission District Programme Manager's Office, Thrissur.
